SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-08: CQL — Nullological Operators. Test these items: Coalesce, IsNull, IsFalse, IsTrue. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 Appendix B Table 9-E + ToInteger/ToLong signatures (live fetch 2026-08-20): no Decimal->Integer/Long conversion exists; ToInteger overloads are Boolean/String/Long only
issues.evidence: ToInteger(1.5)->1, ToInteger(-1.5)->-1, ConvertsToInteger(1.5)->True on BOTH py/cpp (working-tree CQL-07 master truncation branch in macros/conversion.py). Campaign tests test_cql01 TestCanConvert::test_can_convert_false and test_primitive_parity test_..._spec_boundaries expect False/None per spec. No official fixture pins truncation (only ToInteger('-25')=-25).
issues.root_cause: CQL-07 SKEPTIC master added DECIMAL truncation to ToInteger macro + ConvertsToInteger/Long Decimal acceptance based on misread spec claim; CQL 1.5 Table 9-E (verified live 2026-08-20) defines no Decimal->Integer/Long conversion.
issues.resolution: Removed DECIMAL truncation branch from ToInteger macro (macros/conversion.py); ConvertsToInteger/ConvertsToLong return False for Decimal (udf/conversion.py) so ToLong(Decimal)->None; updated CQL-07 truncation pins in test_conversion_function_parity.py to spec behavior; regression test test_cql_to_integer_long_reject_decimal_cql08_historian (py+cpp).
issues.verified_in: nullological parity 15/15; conversion_function_parity 18 passed incl. updated tests; full conformance 2832/2832

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 Coalesce: arguments must be implicitly castable to a common type; Integer and String are not (Table 9-E)
issues.evidence: Coalesce(1, Coalesce(null, 'a')) translates OK then raises raw DuckDB 'Binder Error: Cannot mix values of type INTEGER_LITERAL and VARCHAR' at execution on both paths, instead of the typed TranslationError the flat form Coalesce(1,null,'a') raises. Nested Coalesce static type not propagated through the guard.
issues.root_cause: _infer_static_cql_type_for_logical_operand returned "Any" for FunctionRef coalesce, so nested Coalesce calls escaped the SKEPTIC static type-family guard.
issues.resolution: Coalesce now infers its static return type (first non-Any argument type per CQL 1.5 Sec.Coalesce) in _operators.py; nested String/numeric mixes raise the same typed TranslationError as the flat form. Regression test test_cql_coalesce_nested_static_type_guard_cql08_historian (reject 3 forms, accept 4 forms, py+cpp).

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 ToString Table 9-G + CQL-06 calendar-keyword doctrine (units rendered bare when calendar duration keyword)
issues.evidence: test_structural_type_parity.py::test_cql_structural_quantity_assertion_preserves_fhir_quantity_comparison pins GestationalAgeToString == "38 'weeks'" but BOTH engines now produce "38 weeks" (newer CQL-06 macro fix; 'cm' still quoted "37 'cm'"). Stale expectation vs newer spec-grounded fix.
issues.root_cause: Test pin predated the CQL-06 calendar-duration-keyword QuantityToString fix; both engines already agree on the spec-correct "38 weeks".
issues.resolution: Updated pin in test_structural_type_parity.py to "38 weeks" with doctrine comment; 22/22 structural parity tests pass.

issues.evidence: Re-verified SKEPTIC fixes this launch: 7+-arg Coalesce works both paths; String/numeric static mix raises uniform TranslationError both orders. Prior LOW INTENDED pins (IsTrue/IsFalse lenient non-Boolean -> false; IsNotNull superset) re-confirmed harmless.
